sections.shortTitle: Banks Nationalization Payment of Compensation Rules 1974
sections.description:
BANKS (NATIONALIZATION) (PAYMENT OF COMPENSATION) RULES, 1974
BANKS (NATIONALIZATION) (PAYMENT OF COMPENSATION) RULES,1974
(Amendment)
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part II, 2nd July 1979]
S.R.O.587(I)/79.‑In
exercise of the powers conferred, by section 20 of the Banks (Nationalization)
Act, 1974 (XIX of 1974), the Federal Govern ment is pleased to direct that the
following further amendment shall be made in the Banks (Nationalization)
(Payment of Compensation) Rules, 1974, namely :‑‑‑
In the aforesaid Rules, in rule 2‑A,
in sub‑rule (1), for the figures, letters, words and comma "30th day
of June 1979" the figures, letters, words and comma "31st day of
December 1979" shall be substituted.
[No. F. 1(7) Banking IV/78‑1078].
